title: Minimalist Gengar 100+ Colour Palettes (Parallax) (Customisable) Color
description:
Featuring 100 Colour Palettes based on Pokémon designs from Generations 1-9! Full list at the bottom of the Description

To Change the Colour Palette, click on the Pokéball :D
or you can set it to change every Hour or new Day :>
You can hide the Guide Message in the Settings

Includes a Clock for Date, Day and Time alongside 2 Equaliser variants

This wallpaper is packed full of Customisation, including :
- Parallax
- Bloom
- Eye Tracking
- Gengar Movement
- Pixelate
- Film Grain
- CRT Lines
- Paper Texture
- Colour Palette Name
- Colour Palette Swatch
- Auto Colour Palette Swap Day/Hour/Minute

Featuring 5 renditions of Lavender Town! :
- Lavender Town - Violin
- Lavender Town - RGBY
- Lavender Town - Cello
- Lavender Town - Pokémon Sleep
- Lavender Town - Piano

The music player has all these songs in a playlist. You can Cycle, Shuffle, Repeat, Skip or go to the previous Song as well as adjusting the volume or muting
